audit.corrected: Added the lantern-shield fact to the Key Ability Interactions report entry and to dosFull[1].

edits.before: Q the pair — the tornado tick chips duos that stand in formation.
edits.after: His Q Death Sentence outranges your E — body-block it, don't trade.

edits.before: W charge threat begins: the taunt governs their engage plans already.
edits.after: His Q-into-Flay spike beats your slower charge — respect hook range.

edits.before: Full kit: E-W the committed trade and the magic shield refunds their poke.
edits.after: Full kit now, but his hook-into-Flay pressure still outpaces your W charge.

edits.before: Zone with taunt threat and shield the margins — AP duos pay double rent.
edits.after: Lantern and Flay let him disengage or punish your all-in before it lands.

edits.before: Hero's Entrance online — every roam your duo survives, you end.
edits.after: Hero's Entrance is an AoE lock-in Death Sentence can't Lantern away.

edits.before: First item: the taunt rotation chunks and the MR makes mage supports cry.
edits.after: His Lantern peel and Box slow out-value your all-in around your cooldowns.

edits.before: Late Galio is the anti-dive: taunt their engage off your carry and R the map's emergencies.
edits.after: Late Galio is the anti-dive: your AoE lockdown and E-Q out-teamfight his single-target hook.

edits.before: Bait the answer, start the chain, and let your carry collect — engage trades are all-or-nothing; pick the all.
edits.after: Dark Passage lantern only saves him — his caught ally still eats your E-W combo, so finish the kill.

edits.before: Engaging into a banked disengage — the chain that starts answered is a donation with armor.
edits.after: His Flay wind-up punishes haste — trading into a banked hook just resets his cooldown free.

edits.before: Track Thresh’s Death Sentence: The hook starts the lantern chain — dodge it and the playbook waits 19 seconds. Forward steps wait for its downtime.
edits.after: Track Thresh’s Death Sentence: dodging it stalls his kit 19s. Dark Passage shields whoever it hits — force it before you commit.

notes: Level chart's side field carried the literal word "Skill" on all 7 rows for this matchup; content win[] already had the correct verdicts so only side/rating/why were edited (no content-layer edit needed, avoiding a no-op).
